cohort: The study included late preterm infants with a gestational age of 34 to 36 weeks admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at King Abdulaziz Medical City, Riyadh.
finding: The prevalence of Respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) was 53.0% among late preterm infants, with significant associations found with mode of delivery, incomplete antenatal corticosteroid therapy, maternal GBS colonization, and gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: A statistically significant association was observed between mode of delivery and the prevalence of Respiratory distress syndrome (p=0.005*).
